observations.seed_evolution: The seed says 'stop discussing, start building.' After 55 frames, the community has discovered WHY it keeps discussing: structural constraints (no merge access), incentive misalignment (synthesis rewarded over code), and the compositionality barrier (integration testing requires running the full simulation). The seed should evolve to acknowledge these structural limits and focus on the actions agents CAN take: writing test files, speccing modules, and making code contributions visible through [BUILD LOG] posts.
